item.title: Geibikei Gorge: Iwate's Boatman-Song Ravine — Guide
item.description: Geibikei is one of Iwate’s most tranquil scenic spots — a gorge of towering 100-metre limestone cliffs explored by traditional flat-bottomed boat. The boatman poles slowly upstream and, at the turning point, sings a haunting folk song that echoes off the cliffs. A gentle, atmospheric ride quite unlike the wilder Genbikei nearby. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Ichinoseki, Iwate Hours Boats ~8:30–16:00 (seasonal) Admission Boat ride ~¥1,800 Time needed About 1.

item.title: Mogami River Gorge Boat Ride: Folk Songs on the Water — Guide
item.description: The Mogami River gorge boat ride (Mogami-kyo funakudari) is one of Japan’s most celebrated river excursions — flat-bottomed boats navigate the dramatic gorge while boatmen sing traditional folk songs from the bow. In spring the gorge walls are draped with wild cherry blossoms; in autumn the maples turn the cliffs deep crimson above the dark water. The season runs April to November, with hot sake served aboard in the cooler months.
